book.name: Yohana
book.title: Amangʼana amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Yohana

content: “Nibhabhuuriiri goosi gano okubha mutatiga kuniikirirya.
Nawe abhaatu bharabha bharabhaahura emwe muziinyuumba zye eziisaango zyaabhu. Riraaza eriibhaga rino eraabhe omuutu arabhiita, ariiseega kubha arakora emirimo gya Taatabhugya.
Bharabhakorera ego, kwe ekigirirye bhatamumenyiri Taata, kweeki bhataanimenyiri enye.

Nawe nibhabhuuriiri gayo, okubha eriibhaga ryaabhu ryo okukora gayo hano riraahike, muhiite kubha nibhabhuuriiri. Emirimo gye Ekoro Muhoreeru “Nitaabhabhuuriiri gayo goosi kubhutaangiro, kwe ekigirirye niari hamwe neemwe.
Ambe, bhoono ndagya kuwuno yantumiri. Nawe atariho wowoosi gati weenyu wuno akuumbuurya, ‘Mbe, oragya hayi?’
Mune ebhigoongi bhukongʼu muziikoro zeenyu kwo okubha ndabhabhuurira kubha ndagya ku Taata.
“Ndabhabhuurira obhuheene, ereenderwa enye nigeende, kwo okubha yiingabheeri nitakugya ku Taata, Omusakirya ataari kuuza kweemwe. Nawe eraabhe ndagya, ndamutuma yiize kweemwe.
Hano araaze, arabha arabheerekya abhaatu bhoosi ebho ni bhatemya bhe ebhibhi, na neenye ni we eheene, kweeki Taatabhugya araaza okubhatinira ekiina.
Arabha arabheerekya ebho ni bhatemya bhe ebhibhi, kwo okubha bhatakuniikirirya enye.
Areerekya kyeego enye ni we eheene, kwo okubha ndagya ku Taata na mutakuundora kweeki.
Arabha arabheerekya mwaasi kubha Taatabhugya arabhatinira ekiina, kwe ekigirirye amutiniiri ekiina Seetaani omukaangati we ekyaaro kino.
“Nikyaari ninago amangʼana maaru go okubhabhuurira, nawe eriibhaga rino mutakunagya kugamenya.

Ekoro wuyo Omuhoreeru, wuno ahaakuundukura obhuheene, hano akuuza kweemwe, arabhakaangata kumenya obhuheene. Atakugaamba kwo obhuturo bhwaaye omweene, nawe aragaamba gano yiigwiiri no okubhabhuurira gano garaarorekane.
Ekoro wuyo arabhakuundukurira abhaatu obhuguungo bhwaane, kwo okubha arabhabhuurira amangʼana goosi gano obhona akugagega kureka kweenye.
Ebhigiro bhyoosi bhino Taata anabhyo ni bhyaane. Nikyo ekigirirye kino nigaambiri kubha, Ekoro wuyo arabhabhuurira goosi gano akugega kweenye.
Ebhigoongi bhiraaza kwiikyoora kubha obhuzomererwa
“Rikyaari ibhaga isuuhu neemwe mutakunirora, nawe okumara ibhaga isuuhu kweeki muraandora.”

Ambe, abhaanabheega bhaaye abhaandi bhakiibhuurya, “Mbe, obhugazuro bhwa gano niki, ‘Rikyaari ibhaga isuuhu neemwe mutakuundora, nawe okumara ibhaga isuuhu kweeki muraandora,’ na ‘Kwo okubha ndagya ku Taata’?”
Ambe, bhakageenderera okwiibhuurya, “Obhugazuro bhwaku niki, ‘Eriibhaga isuuhu?’ Etwe tutakumenya gano akubhuga.”

Yeesu akamenyeekererya kubha bhakeenda okumubhuurya gano akubhuga, okumara akabhabhuurya, “Mbe, muriibhuurya gano nibhugiri, ‘Rikyaari ibhaga isuuhu neemwe mutakunirora, nawe okumara ibhaga isuuhu kweeki muraandora’?
Ndabhabhuurira obhuheene, emwe murarira no okubha ne ebhigoongi, nawe abhaatu bhe ekyaaro kino bharazomererwa. Murabha ne ebhigoongi, nawe ebhigoongi bhyeenyu bhiriikyoora kubha obhuzomererwa.

Kyeego omukari akugya okwiituurania omwaana, arabha ne ebhigoongi kwo okubha eriibhaga rye enyaako yaaye rihikiri. Nawe hano akumara kwiituurania, atakuhiita kweeki enyaako yiyo yo obhusuungu, kwe ekigirirye kyo obhuzomererwa bhwo okwiibhurwa omwaana mukyaaro.

Kweego ego na neemwe mwoosi mune ebhigoongi kwiibhaga rino. Nawe ndaaza kweeki kweemwe, ambe murabha no obhuzomererwa muziikoro zyeenyu. Atariho wuno akuruusyaho obhuzomererwa bhuyo muziikoro zyeenyu.
Kweeki eriibhaga riyo hano riraahike, mutakumbuurya ngʼana yoyoosi. “Ndabhabhuurira obhuheene, goosi gano muraasabhe kuriina ryaane, Taata arabhaha.
Tee bhoono, mukyaari kusabha kyokyoosi ku Taatabhugya kuriina ryaane. Musabhe neewe arabhaha, okubha obhuzomererwa bhweenyu bhukuunaane.
Yeesu azihiziri eziinguru mbiihu zye ekyaaro
“Ndabhabhuurira goosi gayo kwe enzira ye ebhireengyo. Eriibhaga riraaza rino nitakugaamba neemwe kwe enzira ye ebhireengyo, nawe ndabhabhuurira mwaasi iguru wa Taata.
Mwiibhaga riyo, kuriina ryaane muramusabha Taatabhugya. Nitakugaamba kubha enye ndabhasabhira ku Taata.
Taata omweene abhaseegiri emwe, kwo okubha muunseegiri enye, kweeki mwiikiriirye kubha nikarwa ku Taata.
Nikaaza mukyaaro kino okurwa ku Taata, nawe bhoono ndarwa mukyaaro hano, ndakyoora ku Taata.”
Ambe abhaanabheega bhaaye bhakamubhuurira, “Bhoono otaangiri okugaamba na neetwe okutama ebhireengyo!
Bhoono tumenyiri kubha omenyiri goosi, naabhe akyaari muutu kukubhuurya kyokyoosi. Gayo nigo gatukoriri okwiikirirya kubha okarwa ku Taatabhugya.”
Yeesu akabhabhuurya, “Mbe, mutaangiri okwiikirirya bhoono?
Eriibhaga riisukiri, kweeki riri haguhi bhukongʼu, hano bhoosi muraanyaragane. Bhoosi muragya oweenyu, no okunitiga omweene ego. Nawe nitakubha omweene ego, kwo okubha Taata ari hamwe neenye.
Ndabhabhuurira gano goosi okubha mubhe no omureembe muziikoro zyeenyu, kwo okubha muri muusi waane. Mukyaaro hano murabhona eziinyaako nzaru, nawe muteme ekubhi kwo okubha enye nikihiziri ekyaaro.”
